Written on the scabbard of his sword are the words, "The only thing I get from killing a man, is the blood on my blade."

Carved into the side of a helmet is the sentence, "When the power of love overcomes the love of power, Estor will have peace."

Written on the outside right of a metal breastplate is, "An elf champion of Vulcan hates a bastard son of the king, and thousands of us die for their grudges."
